in_sanskrit.name: सूर्यवज्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सूर्यः (Surya) - the Sun वज्रः (Vajra) - Thunderbolt, a weapon of the God Indra So, Sunjay means 'Victory of the Sun' or 'Thunderbolt of the Sun'

in_hindi.name: सूर्यजय
in_hindi.meaning: सूर्य (Surya) + जय (Jaya) = Victory of the Sun
in_hindi.long_meaning: सूर्य (Surya) - सूर्यादित्यः (Surya-Aditya) - the Sun जय (Jaya) - Victory So, Sunjay means 'Victory of the Sun' in Hindi

in_tamil.name: சூர்யஜய
in_tamil.long_meaning: சூர்யம் (Chooram) - Sun ஜயம் (Jayam) - Victory So, Sunjay means 'Sun's Victory' in Tamil

in_telugu.name: శూర్యజై
in_telugu.long_meaning: శూర్యము (Chooruymu) - Sun జై (Jai) - Victory So, Sunjay means 'Sun's Victory' in Telugu

in_marathi.name: Sunjay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born of the Sun, Joyful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sunjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sunjay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Surya' meaning Sun and 'Jaya' meaning Victory or Triumph. It signifies a person born under the auspicious rays of the Sun, bringing joy and happiness in life.
